Departmental Application Fee Waiver Request Procedure

Overview
The Graduate Admissions Committee offers application fee waivers to prospective students demonstrating financial hardship or participation in sponsored academic programs.

Step 1: Check Eligibility Criteria
Applicants must review the fee waiver eligibility categories on the graduate school admissions website prior to initiating a request.

Step 2: Obtain Letter of Recommendation
Request a formal letter of recommendation or letter of financial support from your current undergraduate department chair or academic advisor.

Step 3: Submit Fee Waiver Request Form
Complete the online Graduate Application Fee Waiver Form and attach your advisor's letter and proof of program participation.

Step 4: Departmental Review
The Departmental Admissions Committee reviews fee waiver submissions and transmits decisions directly via email. Please note that application processing occurs continuously throughout the year and requests are evaluated in the order received.

For questions regarding fee waivers:
Contact: Graduate Admissions Coordinator
Email: grad-waivers@stateuniversity.edu
Phone: (555) 321-7654
